title: Statistical warning indicators for abrupt transitions in dynamical systems with slow periodic forcing
summary: There is growing interest in anticipating critical transitions in natural systems, often pursued through statistical detection of early warning signals associated with dynamical bifurcations. In stochastic dynamical systems, such signals commonly rely on manifestations of critical slowing down. However, we still need additional development for the underlying theory for critical transitions in non-autonomous systems.
